messages:
evan: quick heads-up for tonight's deploy (01:00 UTC) for ingest-service: trying a micro-ramp FF to test cold KV-cache behavior before full switch.

ez: plan: deploy with flag OFF. schedule: +7m -> 0.5%, +20m -> 5%, +45m -> 50%, +75m -> 100%. on any spike: rollback+pin to ingest-v1.

mike: guardrails?

ez: error_rate > 0.6% for 3m, p95 delta > 75ms, or queue depth > 120 -> pause then rollback.

deploy-bot: scheduled toggle tb-6480101111-B; flag=ingest_kv_v2; steps=[+7m:0.5%,+20m:5%,+45m:50%,+75m:100%]; rollback_triggers=[err>0.6,p95>75,queue>120]; sticky_cohort=internal_canary; initiator=evan

ops-oncall: pre-created pin pin-6480101111-eu (router->ingest-v1), will apply on rollback. kill: `deploy-bot rollback tb-6480101111-B`. dashboard link posted.

(smoke-bot posts)
```
Deploy started: ingest-service v2
Image: registry/redwood/ingest:v2
FF ingest_kv_v2=OFF
Instances: 10
Healthchecks: passing
```

smoke-bot: initial smoke OK. p95 baseline 120ms.

deploy-bot: 0.5% toggle executed @01:07.

smoke-bot: post-step @01:12: p95 +8ms, error rate 0.05%.

deploy-bot: 5% toggle executed @01:20.

ops-oncall: alert infra.queue_depth rising to 130 @01:23 -> pause.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by alert infra.queue_depth. awaiting manual_confirm_on_pause.

ev: pausing. can ops share top queues and traces 01:15-01:25?

ops-oncall: traces show backlog on worker-7 due to longer fetches from cold KV. applying temporary throttling to smooth load.

mike: given queue > threshold, decision: rollback and pin.

deploy-bot: rollback executed @01:25: flag ingest_kv_v2=OFF; pin applied pin-6480101111-eu.

ops-oncall: pin verified, traffic restored to v1. post-rollback smoke green.

ev: adding release note: "micro-ramp paused due to queue spike from cold-KV fetches; rollback executed and routing pinned to v1. Follow-up ticket #3348."

mike: retro: next time start at 0.1% for cold-KV services and add pre-check for queue<80.

deploy-bot: tb-6480101111-B closed: reason=manual rollback; closed_by=mike; closed_at=6480101185
